messages:
lee: saw a diff during routine sweep: runtime shows flag `route.priority_v4=false` for tenant `orchard` but no console_audit entry. timing ~03:11 UTC.

tara: hmm. any sign of agent override or apply-without-persist?

mike: logs show a runtime apply call at 03:11:07 with `persist=false` and control-plane returned 200. control-plane audit store returned timeout. runtime applied but audit wasn't recorded.

lee: that matches other reports. short fixes: (1) make runtime return 5xx when audit write times out (fail-closed), (2) add `X-Audit-Id` & `X-Audit-Retry` headers to responses, (3) reconciler should surface orphaned runtime changes in console.

tara: for console, show "Unrecorded runtime change" with evidence (trace ids) and actions: Backfill Audit (requires justification) or Revert Runtime. make backfill idempotent by evidence-hash.

mike: I'll take backend for fail-closed + headers. plan: patch in 2h to staging, canary overnight. also add gauge `runtime_unrecorded_changes_total{tenant}` and an alert when >0 for 5m.

lee: I'll draft the reconciler flow and console CTA. include API to submit evidence and to mark backfills as operator-approved.

recon-bot: Created recon job R-2025-88 to emit diffs and evidence into queue `reconciler.orphans`.

tara: nice. also add a nightly job that auto-backfills low-risk diffs (agent-override with no capacity impact) and surfaces high-risk ones for manual ack.

lee: agreed. opening INC-2025-360 for tracking (owners: mike backend, lee console, tara recon).

mike: thanks. will post canary results here.
